findings.description: compute_price builds a fresh list of every discount rule on each call, allocating the same immutable data repeatedly in a hot path.
findings.suggested_action: Move the discount-rule list to a module-level constant so each call reuses one allocation.

findings.description: pricing.py performs no file or network I/O; all pricing work is CPU-bound, so batching or async I/O would bring no benefit here.
